events.verdict: Miller (CHA) and Avdija (POR) come together at the same spot, and the contact after Miller's gather is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) legally contests Avdija's (POR) shot attempt.
Camara (POR) contests Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.
Diabate (CHA) deflects the ball away from Williams III (POR) during his shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) and Grant (POR) come together at the same spot as they pursue the rebound.
Camara (POR) does not establish a legal guarding position outside the restricted area prior to the contact with Bridges (CHA).
Knueppel (CHA) deflects the ball away from Avdija (POR).
Diabate (CHA) establishes himself in Grant's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Diabate (CHA) establishes himself in Grant's (POR) path prior to the contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Williams III (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Williams III cleanly blocks Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt and lands short of Knueppel as he returns to the floor.  The ensuing lower body contact is caused by Knueppel and does not affect Williams III's ability to defend.  At the time of the whistle, neither team had imminent possession and play resumes with a jump ball.
Ball (CHA) initiates contact to Avdija's (POR) arm as he passes the ball, and the contact is more than marginal.
Knueppel (CHA) moves alongside Avdija's (POR) path as he defends the drive.
Bridges (CHA) makes contact with the ball as Avdija (POR) attempts to pass.
Grant (POR) initiates contact with Knueppel (CHA), who has established a legal guarding position in his path and outside the restricted area prior to the contact.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on Bridges (CHA).
Bridges (CHA) places his hand momentarily on Avdija's (POR) hip during the inbound.
